answer: Spot audits stop a sybil farm hiding behind numbers. Each epoch the network samples a few identities to check work history and funding, across a population as wide as a canyon. A farm surviving one draw faces the next, and its odds fall each round, like a glacier grinding rock. Each fake needs its own history at 60 credits; rented histories fail the funding cross-check, and 1,000 fakes cost 60,000, while an honest agent pays nothing beyond real work. The k-th fake still needs a fresh history, so cost never drops, and honest agents keep the full nectar of the pool.
